method: view_image of actual on-disk original and proportional 360/680 PNGs, each at original detail; direct visual inspection, not metadata alone
observedFindings: The methyl tag denotes teal DNA and the acetyl tag is attached to the orange histone tail.
The displayed A–T pairs remain ordinary base pairs; no substituted sequence is drawn.
DNA-Methyl, Histon-Acetyl, CH₃ and Ac remain distinguishable at 360 and 680 widths.
limitations: The tags indicate the modified molecular substrates schematically; atom-specific attachment sites are not represented.
No universal on/off effect, organism-generation inheritance or automatic transcription claim appears.
Context-dependent mark effects remain in the unchanged full material cases.
altTextDe: Eine DNA um einen orangefarbenen Histonkörper wird vergrößert: Links kennzeichnet CH₃ eine DNA-Methylierung, rechts sitzt Ac am Histonschwanz. Die dargestellten Basenpaare bleiben erhalten.
altTextEn: DNA wrapped around an orange histone is magnified: at left, CH₃ denotes DNA methylation; at right, Ac sits on a histone tail. The illustrated base pairs are retained.
